hard_frame.rule: Continue from first frame as State #0; use last frame as final state when present.

reference.rule: Explicitly bind each reference to identity/product/place/motion/camera/voice/style purpose.

multi_shot.rule: Use time ranges for narrative/camera/action pacing.

edit.rule: Specify target time range and preserve all unrequested content.

extend.rule: Continue from @Video 1 with state, voice, scene, style and audio continuity.

productionRules: Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 use different duration, resolution and reference budgets.
Seedance 2.0 cannot use audio as the sole reference.
Seedance 2.5 can use large reference bundles and supports two automatic extension turns under the current conservative profile.
Real-human image/video references on BytePlus require approved LAS material-library handling.
Do not assume direct hard-frame + arbitrary multimodal-reference mixing unless endpoint verification explicitly enables it.
